content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UCSL Draftsman Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of UCSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UCSL Draftsman (Mechanical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the UCSL Draftsman (Mechanical) posts is 08 October 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a State Board of Technical Education with a minimum of 60% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Draftsman (Mechanical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for Ex-servicemen as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for UCSL Draftsman (Mechanical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is ₹ 400/-. There is no application fee for SC/ST category candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Draftsman (Mechanical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Objective type offline Test (Phase I), followed by a Practical Test in CAD (Phase II), and finally Certificate Verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post will receive a salary of Rs. 31926 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Draftsman (Mechanical) post in the Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the UCSL Draftsman (Mechanical) recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL) located?
faq.answer: Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL) is located in Malpe, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. When does the online application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process for the UCSL Draftsman (Mechanical) recruitment commences on 17 September 2026.
